title: Boox Palma 2 Pro E-Reader Released
excerpt: The $400 Boox Palma 2 Pro offers a smartphone-sized E Ink display for reading books, articles, and documents.
body_html: The newly introduced Boox Palma 2 Pro is a compact, smartphone-sized e-reader priced at $400. It is built specifically for users who prefer reading books, documents, and articles on a smaller E Ink screen rather than a traditional mobile device.
